review.why: Audits a deployed Vercel project for cost and speed using real metrics first, deterministic gates and ranked, cited recommendations.
review.summary: Collects Vercel metrics, usage, configuration and code scan results into a signals file, investigates only metric-backed candidates and writes a ranked report. Rules: metrics first, read only files a candidate names, cite only a versioned docs library. It lists supported frameworks and prerequisites and says never to type tokens into commands.
strengths: Recommendations start from production signals, not repo-wide guesses
Unsupported frameworks stop and ask before auditing
Invalid or version-mismatched citations are stripped
cautions: Large: dozens of bundled scripts that are not read here
Needs an authenticated CLI, a linked project and a paid observability plan for route metrics
